children.text: PLATFORM

children.name: Article Title
children.text: Remote agent gateway

children.name: Article Lead
children.text: Run one central Gameplane API and dashboard, plus an operator and an optional gateway in each remote cluster. The gateway proxies approved agent operations over mTLS so the central dashboard can reach consoles, files, players and captures in clusters it does not run in.

children.name: Article Callout Text
children.text: The agent gateway is available since v0.3.0.

children.name: Article Callout Text
children.text: The central API still reaches each Kubernetes API directly for resources, Pod logs and PTY attach. The gateway is not a Kubernetes tunnel and has no database or login.

children.name: Section Title 1
children.text: What the gateway carries

children.name: Section Body 1
children.text: The gateway extends registered clusters with console, file management, player operations, live status and captures. Registry browsing and modpacks use the selected cluster's Kubernetes client and game template.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 0
children.text: RCON console, game logs, file manager, player operations and server status

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 1
children.text: Agent-based mods and UID-bound capture files

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 2
children.text: Registry browsing and modpacks use the selected cluster's Kubernetes client

children.name: Section Title 1
children.text: Deploy the gateway with Helm

children.name: Section Body 1
children.text: Use matching API, operator and agent versions. Create Secrets for server TLS, central client CA, and agent credentials, then install with Helm setting api.enabled=false and gateway.enabled=true.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 0
children.text: clusterID must match the Cluster resource name exactly

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 1
children.text: Create Role and RoleBinding in each configured namespace with read-only get access

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 2
children.text: Configure NetworkPolicy for central API CIDRs, Kubernetes API endpoints, DNS, and game agent traffic

children.name: Section Title 2
children.text: Register the gateway centrally

children.name: Section Body 2
children.text: Combined installs: create a labeled credential Secret in the central API namespace and add the gateway reference to the Cluster resource. Standalone panels: PUT /clusters/<name>/gateway.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 0
children.text: Create Secret with ca.crt, tls.crt and tls.key for central client authentication

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 1
children.text: Client certificate must chain to gateway.centralClientCASecret and carry the gateway URI SAN

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 2
children.text: Registration name must match the gateway's clusterID

children.name: Section Title 3
children.text: Verify the installation

children.name: Section Body 3
children.text: Confirm the gateway Pod is Ready, the cluster reports healthy, and test console, file manager and players on a test server.

children.name: Quick Reference Label
children.text: GATEWAY

children.name: Quick Reference Line 1
children.text: 01  Secrets first: server TLS, central client CA, agent client + CA

children.name: Quick Reference Line 2
children.text: 02  Helm: api.enabled=false, gateway.enabled=true, clusterID, peerURI, NetworkPolicy CIDRs

children.name: Quick Reference Line 3
children.text: 03  Central: labeled Secret + Cluster agentGateway, or panel API

children.name: Quick Reference Line 4
children.text: 04  Verify a test server end to end; Cluster health is Kubernetes-only
